worker_id_exclusion_reason: worker_id is a synthetic sequential row identifier (data_generator.generate_dataset: worker_id = np.arange(1, n+1)) with no causal relationship to loan_repaid. An earlier model version (feature_names had 16 entries, worker_id first) accidentally fit on it as a scaled input, which let the arbitrary identifier value materially shift predictions and risk categories with no real information behind it. See ml-engine/models/MODEL_CARD.md.
income_unit: undocumented/synthetic — NOT confirmed to be INR, USD, or any real currency. Do not assume a currency or apply a conversion factor without an explicit, sourced decision. See ml-engine/models/MODEL_CARD.md.
